context: At the accepted object, finalize calls flush_buffer, stream flush and stream close BEFORE the try/except that assigns the failed state; later recovery/artifact/publication errors assign failed. v1's universal statement that finalize failure moves the writer to failed is therefore inaccurate. These rows separate observed in-memory state, usability and the last durable manifest. No writer-fault test was executed.

invariants: Report observed in-memory writer state, supported usability evidence and last durable manifest independently for each stage.
